name: openscience
description: One-install access to 23 life-sciences MCP servers (PubChem, Ensembl, UniProt, PDB, AlphaFold, GEO, ClinVar, gnomAD, PubMed, and more) — vendored from Claude Science and fully self-contained.

contact_email.title: Contact email (NCBI etiquette)
contact_email.description: NCBI E-utilities (PubMed, dbSNP, ClinVar, GEO) ask callers to identify themselves with a contact email. Some tools require it. Leave blank to skip those calls.

ncbi_api_key.title: NCBI API key (optional)
ncbi_api_key.description: Optional NCBI API key to raise the E-utilities rate limit from 3 to 10 requests/second.
